title: A Day at the Park
text:
Tom likes the playground. He plays on the slide and the swings with his friends. It is a sunny day in spring.

In autumn, the leaves are red and yellow. Tom and his sister like to jump in the leaves. They go home when it gets cold.

questions.text: What do Tom and his sister jump in?
How does Tom probably feel about the autumn leaves?
What can we guess about Tom's sister?
options: She likes jumping in the leaves
She does not like the park

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor area with equipment for children to play on
a long smooth structure that children go down
seats hung from bars that children sit on and move back and forth
the flat green or colored parts that grow on trees

paragraph_translations: Tom le gusta el parque infantil. Juega en el tobogán y en los columpios con sus amigos. Es un día soleado de primavera.
En otoño, las hojas son rojas y amarillas. Tom y su hermana les gusta saltar entre las hojas. Vuelven a casa cuando hace frío.
